_comment: PERF-A2 default input track (docs/AUTONOMOUS_PERF_TEST.md D2): walks the main hall centerline (x=0) forward at MOVE_SPEED=6.0 m/s for ~10 s, a 2 s two-key turn (W+D + 30 deg/s right), then idles 3 s, then loops. Total 15 s of motion per loop; at -Dmindpalace.frameLock=8.3 that is ~1800 sim frames/loop. Snapshot frames are rendered-frame indexes (deterministic under frame lock): mid-walk (150), turn entry (950), late turn (1250).
